description:
## X Patch 1.12.2-x.7 — fix native long-press sheet branch bypass

All six patches can be selected together for X 12.31.0-prod.01 and 12.32.0-prod.01: Fix external post links; Hide Find more; Hide Who to follow; Hide sports scores (experimental); Hide search relevance prompt (experimental); Copy media URL (image/video/GIF from post options and direct image/video/GIF URL from media long-press). Existing filters are retained. The native image/video long-press action sheet gets a separate Copy media URL row without replacing built-in actions. Direct video/GIF URLs prefer the highest-bitrate MP4. The obsolete video downloader hook was removed because it does not match X 12.31.0. The presenter handler lookup was hardened for the Ahmed 1.24.2 coexistence case observed failing in x.3. Version x.7 fixes the normal loop-exit branch skipping the row insertion by transforming the finished immutable media sheet instead of injecting immediately before its conversion. The original rows and selection handler remain intact. Real-APK patch application and isolated immutable-sheet action/callback checks passed; on-device UI and clipboard behavior remain unverified until installed.
